title: Preparation of peptidoglycan-depleted soluble microbial extract
protocol: Transform _E. coli_ BL21 (DE3) cells by heat shock according to the manufacturer's protocol with the pProEx HTa vector containing the full-length PGRP-LB gene.
Plate the transformed cells onto ampicillin-LB agar plates.
Grow the plates at 37 °C overnight.
Pick a single colony and inoculate a starter culture of 2 ml ampicillin-LB medium.
Place the culture in an incubator overnight at 37 °C and 200 r.p.m.
Inoculate 50 ml ampicillin-LB medium in a shaker flask with the morning culture.
Place the culture in an incubator at 37 °C and 200 r.p.m. for 2 h.
Inoculate 1 liter ampicillin-LB medium in a 2-liter flask with the overnight culture.
Grow the cultures in an incubator shaker at 37 °C and 200 r.p.m. until the optical density at 600 nm reaches 1.0.
Place the flasks in an ice water bath to rapidly cool the cultures to 18 °C.
Add IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM for protein expression induction.
Grow the cultures at 18 °C and 200 r.p.m. for 4 h post-induction.
Transfer the cells to centrifuge tubes.
Harvest the cells by centrifuging for 15 min at 5,000g and 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Collect the cell pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 ml of cell lysis buffer at 4 °C with a glass rod until homogeneous.
Place the suspension on ice.
Lysate cells using sonication in a series of 10-s pulses to avoid heating until the suspension loses viscosity.
Centrifuge for 50 min at 15,000g and 4 °C to pellet cellular debris.
Collect the supernatant.
Filtrate the supernatant through a 0.45 μm pore membrane.
Prepare 5 ml of Ni-NTA agarose resin according to the manufacturer's instructions and equilibrate with cell lysis buffer at 4 °C.
Load the supernatant collected in Step 13 onto a column containing the equilibrated Ni-NTA agarose resin.
Wash the column with 50 ml of cell lysis buffer.
Wash the column with 50 ml of 40 mM imidazole wash buffer.
Elute the protein with 15 ml of 200 mM imidazole wash buffer.
Transfer the elution fraction from Step 18 into a dialysis membrane bag (molecular weight cut-off of 3.5 KDa).
Immerse the bag in dialysis buffer (more than 50 times the volume of the elution fraction) and agitate with a magnetic stir bar at 4 °C for 4 h.
Transfer the content of the bag to a clean beaker.
Add TEV-protease according to the manufacturer's instructions and incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Check the cleavage by running SDS-PAGE and comparing the apparent molecular weight of PGRP-LB before and after TEV-protease treatment.
Equilibrate a HiTrapQ column connected to the AKTA HPLC system with the dialysis buffer.
Load the sample from Step 23 onto the HiTrapQ column.
Collect and save the flow-through containing the unbound material.
Apply a linear gradient from the dialysis buffer to NaCl wash buffer over 15 column volumes.
Identify fractions containing PGRP-LB using SDS-PAGE.
Equilibrate a HiTrapSP column connected to the AKTA HPLC system with the dialysis buffer.
Collect the fractions from Step 27 and load the sample onto the HiTrapSP column.
Collect and save the flow-through containing the unbound material.
Apply a linear gradient from the dialysis buffer to the NaCl wash buffer over 15 column volumes.
Identify fractions containing PGRP-LB using SDS-PAGE.
Concentrate PGRP-LB from Step 31 to 6 mg/ml using an VivaSpin 20 centrifugal concentrator following manufacturers' instructions.
Freeze in liquid nitrogen in 100 μl aliquots and store at -80°C.
Inoculate a culture of 100 ml LB medium with _Erwinia carotovora carotovora 15_.
Grow the inoculated culture at 30°C for 16 hours with vigorous shaking (~300 rpm).
Harvest the bacteria by centrifugation at 3,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the pellet twice with 1 ml PBS.
Prepare ~200 mg (wet weight) of bacterial pellet.
Resuspend the bacterial pellet in 2 ml PBS.
Transfer to the centrifuge tube containing 0.5 mm glass beads.
Cell lysis by using Precellys 24 homogenizer at 6,500 rpm for 15 sec; repeat three times.
Lyophilize the lysate.
Resuspend the dry pellet with 2 ml of 100% methanol.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 5 min.
Lyophilize the supernatant.
Dissolve the dry pellet with 1 ml H₂O.
Add 560 ng of recombinant PGRP-LB to SME (50 mg).
Incubate the mixture for 1 h at 25 °C.
